scripts.text: SELECT MarketShortName, GRGR_CK FROM EXTRACT.NourishedRx_Config WHERE ExtractName = 'MemberInbound' AND InboundMemberFileName =  'NRx_Anthem_CT_CKD Nutrition Program_Enrollment'

INSERT INTO EXTRACT.NourishedRx_Log
           (GRGR_CK,ExtractName,ReportRunDate,ReportStartDate,ReportEndDate,NewEnrollments,ReportingPeriodBeginDate_New,ReportingPeriodBeginDate_Exists,ReportingPeriodEndDate,Status,AdhocRun,RecordCount,FileName,FileLocation)
     VALUES
           (@GRGR_CK,'InboundMember',GETDATE(),NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,'In Progress',0,NULL,@InboundFullFileName,@InboundFilePath)


SELECT @@IDENTITY ID

UPDATE log
   SET log.Status = 'Failed'
FROM  EXTRACT.NourishedRx_log log
INNER JOIN (SELECT MAX(ID), GRGR_CK FROM EXTRACT.NourishedRx_Log WHERE Status = 'In Progress' AND ExtractName = 'InboundMember' AND GRGR_CK = @GRGR_CK GROUP BY GRGR_CK) rec
ON log.GRGR_CK = rec.GRGR_CK
AND log.ID = rec.ID

UPDATE log
   SET NewEnrollments = iif((select count(NewEnrollment) from Extract.NourishedRx_Stage_Member) > 0,1,0)
	  ,RecordCount = (select count(*) from Extract.NourishedRx_Stage_Member)
	  ,Status = 'Completed Successfully'
FROM  EXTRACT.NourishedRx_log log
INNER JOIN (SELECT MAX(ID) ID, GRGR_CK FROM EXTRACT.NourishedRx_Log WHERE Status = 'In Progress' AND ExtractName = 'InboundMember' AND GRGR_CK = @GRGR_CK GROUP BY ExtractName, GRGR_CK) rec
ON log.GRGR_CK = rec.GRGR_CK
AND log.ID = rec.ID

SELECT 'Pharmacy_' + CAST(DATEPART(yyyy, GETDATE()) AS VARCHAR(4)) + RIGHT('0' + CAST(DATEPART(mm, GETDATE()) AS VARCHAR(2)), 2) + RIGHT('0' + CAST(DATEPART(dd, GETDATE()) AS VARCHAR(2)), 2) 
                  + '_' + RIGHT('0' + CAST(DATEPART(hh, GETDATE()) AS VARCHAR(2)), 2) + RIGHT('0' + CAST(DATEPART(mi, GETDATE()) AS VARCHAR(2)), 2) + RIGHT('0' + CAST(DATEPART(ss, GETDATE()) AS VARCHAR(2)), 2) AS Expr1, GETDATE() 
                  AS GETDT

INSERT INTO EXTRACT.NourishedRx_Log         (GRGR_CK,ExtractName,ReportRunDate,ReportStartDate,ReportEndDate,NewEnrollments,ReportingPeriodBeginDate_New,ReportingPeriodBeginDate_Exists,ReportingPeriodEndDate,Status,AdhocRun,RecordCount,FileName,FileLocation)
     VALUES
           (@GRGR_CK,@OutboundExtract,GETDATE(),NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,'In Progress',NULL,NULL,@FileName,@InboundFile)
